title: Randomeffektek
description: This is a Hungarian plugin. You receive a random effect in every chunk. It's still in beta, and an English version will be available. Recommended server version: 1.20.6 | For issues, contact Discord: xjaece
body: This is a Hungarian plugin (currently in beta). You receive a random effect in every chunk, and you can customize which effects you don’t want to receive during the game. An English version will be available in the future. Recommended server version: 1.20.6 | For issues, contact Discord: xjaece
